brief.zh: 减慢范围内的所有僵尸

description.en: Stallias slow down zombies with a puff of perfume.
description.zh: 大丽菊利用一股毒气减慢僵尸的前进。

chat.en: "Life moves too quickly in our modern world," says Stallia. "Folks need to slow down and smell some spores."
chat.zh: “现在大家都总是忙忙碌碌的，”大丽菊说，“人们应该时不时停下脚步闻闻花香。”

text.en: single use, activates when zombie is close
text.zh: 一次性使用，僵尸靠近时触发
对附近的僵尸施加减速效果
